name: Theodore Stratos
original_name: テオドール･ストラトス
source:
An Artifact researcher affiliated with Sephiroth.

He is clumsy with words and bad at expressing his emotions, but deep down, he harbors a strong sense of duty and passionate feelings.

The possessor of a rare <Transmutation> Artifact that converts his own magical power into matter.

At Sephiroth, he is researching the Artifactization of magic and serves as the lead researcher for the  <Rod of Asclepius>, a research project to extract magic formulas from the human body.
